steps.spoken: main landmark, figure, Headshot of Demetri Alexakos, graphic, out of figure, Demetri Alexakos, heading, level 2, i 2i Capacity Building Coach, Demetri Alexakos holds a bachelor’s degree in Political Science from the University of Illinois at Chicago and a master’s in Public Policy and Administration from Northwestern University. With over a decade of experience in economic development nonprofits on Chicago’s South and Southwest Sides, Demetri uses innovative data analysis and Geographic Information System (GIS) visualization to tell the story of communities. His work has deepened his understanding of the power of community outreach and grassroots advocacy. In his free time, Demetri enjoys exploring diverse neighborhoods, finding the perfect spot to hang his hammock between two trees, and attending comedy improv shows, embracing the YES, AND... mindset in both work and life., link

Proficient in various HR facets, he handles talent acquisition, retention, benefits, compensation, employee relations, and marketing strategies. steps.spoken: figure, Headshot of Dr. Michelle Martinez, graphic, out of figure, Dr. Michelle Martinez, heading, level 2, i 2i Capacity Building Coach, Dr. Michelle Martinez is a bilingual (English slash Spanish) clinical psychologist with over 10 years of experience advancing community-based violence prevention and capacity-building efforts across Chicagoland. She is a Mc Nair Scholar and earned her Bachelor’s degree in Psychology from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, and her Master’s and Doctorate in Clinical Psychology from Midwestern University. Her work is grounded in trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and inclusive approaches supporting individuals and organizations. She has led program evaluation, partnered with stakeholders, and co-founded a national initiative supporting emerging professionals from historically underrepresented communities. Dr. Martinez is also a published author and brings a strong foundation in research to her work advancing scalable, equity-driven strategies that strengthen community systems and promote long-term safety and wellness., link

steps.spoken: figure, Headshot of Dr. Tasha Williams, graphic, out of figure, Dr. Tasha Williams, heading, level 2, i 2i Capacity Building Coach, Dr. Tasha Williams has served as an Assistant Professor of Business, Dean of Business Programs, and Dean of Juvenile Correctional Programs at various universities and colleges in Illinois. Dr. Tasha has also served as an Executive Director and Capacity Building Program and Fiscal Manager for community organizations around the State of Illinois. Dr. Tasha earned her bachelor’s degree from the University of Missouri St. Louis in 2007, her master’s in business administration (M dot B dot A) with a concentration in finance from Colorado Technical University in 2009, and her Doctorate in Education, with a focus on Interdisciplinary Leadership and Higher Education, from Governors State University in 2017. Dr. Tasha has developed and implemented mentoring programs for youth serving nonprofit organizations around the State of Illinois. She founded a nonprofit organization called Save One Life Foundation, which works with reentry youth to provide opportunities for them to become productive members of society., link
